name: mirage
text: Yes, several sockets at once is the right design, and I've written it all down as CH58. Right now the live lane can use only one price feed at a time. I'm doing it in this order: (a) the lane's status line now counts games in the feed, in play, in Novig, matched and priced, and I'm reading that to see where tennis drops out; (b) fix whatever that shows, most likely tennis name matching against Novig; (c) a Tennis section in the Live tab with the live score, plus the lane's live bets and bids on those matches, laid out like the other sports; (d) run SharpAPI, SX Bet and BoltOdds together, one as the fair price and the others as second opinions and score sources. Everything stays paper-only until I've read its results. Tennis bets and bids are on in paper now.
